observations: Three photos show two catalytic converters with attached exhaust manifolds, lying on a concrete ground.
Both units appear used, with visible rust, discoloration, and soot buildup.

Photo 0: Two converters side by side. The one on the left has a golden-brown casing with '611' visible. The one on the right has a darker, more corroded casing with a label that is too blurry to read.
Photo 1: Same two units from a different angle. The left unit shows '611' again. The right unit shows a grid-like pattern on its casing.
Photo 2: Same units, slightly rotated. The left unit shows a label with partial text 'VICTOR EXHAUST' and '611'. The right unit's label is still unreadable.
No visible branding or model numbers that clearly identify the vehicle make or model.
The seller claims these are for a Lexus ES350 2010 model, but no such marking is visible on the parts themselves.
The watermark 'VICTOR EXHAUST' appears on all photos, likely the seller's or listing platform's branding, not part of the item.
